name: pkey_free
description: pkey_free() frees a previously allocated protection key, making it available for later allocations. After freeing, the key cannot be used in any protection-key-related operations, and its behavior is undefined if still assigned to an address range.

parameters.name: pkey
parameters.description: The protection key to be freed

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: All protection keys available for the current process have been allocated, or the processor/operating system does not support protection keys (though this is primarily for pkey_alloc())
